item.title: Notiqflow 0.4.7
item.description:
Notiqflow 0.4.7

This update restores dictation for people whose microphone stopped producing text after 0.4.5.

  • Voice Isolation is now opt-in. Some Mac audio configurations accepted the Voice Isolation setup but then delivered no usable microphone samples. Notiqflow now uses the reliable standard microphone path by default.
  • Silent audio capture recovers automatically. If Voice Isolation stalls during a recording, Notiqflow switches to the standard microphone without making you repeat the dictation.
  • Recording failures are no longer silent. A held Fn dictation that captures too little audio now shows a clear error instead of being mistaken for an accidental tap.
  • Model readiness is checked before recording. Notiqflow now tells you immediately if the speech engine is not ready.

No settings or permissions need to be reset after updating.
